coverage_limits: This concentrated review is limited to the four supplied cases, their supplied material-support sources, the supplied law excerpts, templates, and the six supplied reference rows. No external search, other conversation, project history, input-model proposal, trained prediction, or additional law or fact is used.

Decisions assess whether each literal test status is justified by the supplied material at the stated procedural stage. They do not predict or determine the overall case outcome and do not convert support for one test into satisfaction of the full claim.
Prior-court findings are retained at their stated source level and are not treated as approval, adoption, or holdings of the target court unless the supplied material expressly says so.

An inability to infer a proposition is not treated as affirmative refutation; absence of a described alternative is not treated as absence of legal support for other routes; and the scope of an alleged arrangement is kept distinct from proof that the arrangement actually occurred.
Source addresses are preserved only as locators for the supplied quotations and do not independently establish the meaning, weight, or truth of those quotations.

Open-text standards, missing burdens, missing evidentiary rules, missing dates, and facts not stated in the supplied material are not inferred. Genuine uncertainty is preserved rather than resolved by outside assumptions.
